what: A cheap, bookkeeping-only worker tier was refused for writing a small internal note file, even though that exact kind of file was already the tier's intended job.
rule: An allowlist of bookkeeping-only output paths should match the files that tier is actually meant to write.
fix: Enforcement: a small internal note file now matches the bookkeeping allowlist; any other design-content file still goes to a more capable, still inexpensive tier, and the refusal now says so. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-p.test.mjs`.
